name: Agatha
description: One of the three witch sisters, owner of the Soul Cauldron.

description_citations.text: "Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agatha and Callio, stranded on Harborgate, try to snare floating dead bodies to salvage etherium.
timeline.quote: I need them for their etherium.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Callio kills a Bant aven scout with the crossbow and Agatha realizes her sister is a Seeker.
timeline.quote: CALLIO fires at the aven scout, piercing it in the heart.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Callio reveals her daughter Jaria was lost and that the Seekers need etherium.
timeline.quote: My daughter was just one of the mistakes

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Callio integrates etherium into the dead aven and Agatha refuses to help.
timeline.quote: I'm not helping you do anything.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Agatha shoots and kills Callio, then swims to the shore of Jhess.
timeline.quote: The bolt slams into CALLIO's chest.

citation.text: "An Etherium Tale". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sits with Agatha, whose husband was killed, and promises to investigate the murders.
timeline.quote: even now as she tells his wife that she'll do her best to investigate these murders

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Agatha tells Arlinn that a witch is making effigies to help the village.
timeline.quote: That's the witch's doing.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Talion asks Kellan to defeat the three witches Agatha, Hylda and Eriette to break the Wicked Slumber in return for a boon.
timeline.quote: Whosoever is brave enough to defeat them shall break the curse upon the Realm

citation.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citation.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

timeline.summary: Retellings of Agatha's demise make Kellan taller and Ruby stronger, while the core story stays the same.
timeline.quote: With every retelling of Agatha's demise, Kellan got taller and Ruby got stronger.

citation.text: A Tale for the Ages (Wilds of Eldraine Promos, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kellan slams into Agatha and she falls screaming into the cauldron.
timeline.quote: Kellan heard Agatha howl when he slammed into her, heard her scream as she fell into the cauldron, but couldn't afford to think about the implications just yet.

citation.text: Feed the Cauldron (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Agatha befriends the beasts of the wilds, making them bolder and more savage.
timeline.quote: Agatha befriended the beasts of the wilds, and under her influence they grew bolder ... and more savage.

citation.text: Commune with Nature (Wilds of Eldraine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Talion and the three witch sisters cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the invasion; it does not lift.
timeline.quote: had cast the Wicked Slumber on the plane to halt the Invasion

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan, with Ruby, kills Agatha and defeats Hylda.
timeline.quote: Kellan, with the help of Ruby , succeeded in killing Agatha and defeating Hylda.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fae Lord Talion calls Kellan, aged sixteen, and gives him the quest to defeat the witch sisters and end the Wicked Slumber in exchange for information about his father.
timeline.quote: Kellan was called to realm of the Fae Lord Talion

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and rescues Imodane; the Wolf Knight is revealed to be Peter.
timeline.quote: Kellan slays the witch by pushing her into her cauldron

citation.text: "Kellan", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agatha and Callio, stationed at Harborgate, are teleported from Esper into Bant's landscape and scavenge etherium from the dead.
timeline.quote: teleported from Esper to become part of

citation.text: "Agatha (Alara)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agatha is horrified when Callio uses magic to integrate etherium into a dead Bant aven and realizes Callio has long been a Seeker.
timeline.quote: Agatha realized her sister had been a member of the ruthless Seekers of Carmot for years

citation.text: "Agatha (Alara)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agatha defies Callio's command and fatally shoots her.
timeline.quote: She then fatally shot Callio

citation.text: "Agatha (Alara)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agatha swims toward the shore of Jhess to start a new life in Bant.
timeline.quote: She swam toward the shore of

citation.text: "Agatha (Alara)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eriette and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber, receiving the Charmed Apple.
timeline.quote: Talion gave her the Charmed Apple

citation.text: "Eriette", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hylda and her sisters help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the invasion; Talion gives her the Icy Crown.
timeline.quote: Hylda and her sisters Agatha and Eriette helped the faerie Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Hylda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion tasked Imodane with defeating the witch sisters.
timeline.quote: who tasked her with defeating Agatha

citation.text: "Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Agatha and Peter captured Imodane; Kellan killed Agatha and rescued her.
timeline.quote: killing Agatha and rescuing Imodane

citation.text: "Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan slays Agatha by pushing her into her cauldron and rescues Imodane; the Wolf Knight is revealed to be Peter.
timeline.quote: Kellan slew the witch by pushing her into her cauldron

citation.text: "Ruby", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion and the witch sisters create the Wicked Slumber and Talion gives each an artifact.
timeline.quote: They were forced to join with the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda to create the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Talion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Agatha catches Imodane, Talion hands the task to Kellan, promising information about his father.
timeline.quote: Talion handed the task to the half-fae Kellan

citation.text: "Talion", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan kills Agatha in the cauldron and returns it to Talion.
timeline.quote: Kellan killed her by boiling her alive in the cauldron before returning it to Talion.

citation.text: "Talion", section "Talion's gifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion joins the witch sisters to cast the Wicked Slumber to halt the Invasion, giving each a magical artifact.
timeline.quote: Talion provided each of the witches with a magical artifact that enhanced their powers

citation.text: "Wicked Slumber", section "The Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Talion tasks Imodane to kill the witches; she is caught by Agatha.
timeline.quote: Talion tasked the knight Imodane to kill the three witches.

citation.text: "Wicked Slumber", section "The Curse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
